answers.value: All open underwriting referrals awaiting a higher-authority decision that this underwriter originated; scope = the referral queue in the underwriting workstation for the underwriter's book, one referral tracked to closure at a time.

The single risk's line calculation plus a quarterly re-performance sample of 15 bound risks in the same treaty programme.

On a mismatch the risk is held, the Reinsurance Analyst re-derives the figures, and a correcting entry is booked in the reinsurance administration system before binding.
